_rule: An entry needs a primary source URL and an as-of date. No entry => the tax block is hidden. Never copy a state default or another city's rate. Combined = state + local; HSV covers the Garland County portion only.

tx/austin.source: Texas Comptroller city sales tax rate table (Austin, Travis Co.)

id/boise.source: Idaho State Tax Commission (6% state; no Boise local sales tax)

fl/tampa.source: Florida Dept. of Revenue discretionary sales surtax (Hillsborough 1.5%)

az/scottsdale.source: City of Scottsdale tax resources (5.6% state + 0.7% county + 1.70% city, effective 2025-07-01)

tn/nashville.source: Tennessee Dept. of Revenue Notice 24-11 (Davidson local rate 2.75% from 2025-02-01) + 7% state

ok/oklahoma-city.source: City of Oklahoma City (4.5% state + 4.125% city = 8.625%)

ar/hot-springs-village.source: Garland County portion: AR 6.5% + county 1.5% (Avalara); Saline County portion may differ
